summary: TOOL-4 Filter products by category and brand
description:
As a customer, I want to filter so I can narrow down the catalogue.

* Selecting one category → only products from that category appear.
* Selecting two categories → products from both appear.
* Combining a category and a brand → only products matching both appear.
* Unchecking all filters → the full list returns.

criteria.text: Selecting one category → only products from that category appear.
Selecting two categories → products from both appear.
Combining a category and a brand → only products matching both appear.
Unchecking all filters → the full list returns.

cases.title: Selecting a single category shows only that category's products
cases.preconditions: Catalogue page is open with no filters selected. The catalogue contains products from at least two categories (e.g. "Shoes" and "Bags"), and the tester knows which products belong to "Shoes".
steps: Open the catalogue page and note the full list of products shown.
cases.expected: Only products from the "Shoes" category appear in the list; no products from any other category are shown.

cases.title: Selecting two categories shows products from both
cases.preconditions: Catalogue page is open with no filters selected. The catalogue contains products in "Shoes", "Bags" and at least one further category (e.g. "Hats").
steps: Additionally select the category filter "Bags" (both category filters now selected).
cases.expected: Products from both the "Shoes" and the "Bags" categories appear in the list; products from categories that are not selected (e.g. "Hats") are not shown.

cases.title: Combining a category and a brand shows only products matching both
cases.preconditions: Catalogue page is open with no filters selected. The catalogue contains: products in category "Shoes" of brand "BrandA", products in "Shoes" of another brand, and products of "BrandA" in a different category.
cases.expected: Only products that are in the "Shoes" category AND of brand "BrandA" appear. "Shoes" products of other brands and "BrandA" products from other categories are not shown.

cases.title: Unchecking all category filters returns the full list
cases.preconditions: Catalogue page is open with no filters selected; the tester has recorded the full unfiltered product list.
steps: Open the catalogue page and record the full product list.
Select the category filters "Shoes" and "Bags" and confirm the list is filtered.
Uncheck "Bags" so that no filters remain selected.
cases.expected: With no filters selected, the full product list returns and matches the list recorded in step 1.

cases.title: Unchecking all filters after a combined category and brand filter returns the full list
cases.preconditions: Catalogue page is open with no filters selected; the tester has recorded the full unfiltered product list. The catalogue contains products of brand "BrandA" in category "Shoes".
steps: Open the catalogue page and record the full product list.
Select the category filter "Shoes" and the brand filter "BrandA"; confirm the list is filtered.
Uncheck the category filter "Shoes" so that no filters remain selected.
cases.expected: With no filters selected, the full product list returns and matches the list recorded in step 1.
